# Exercises - Summary and Conclusions

## Summary and Conclusions

Book page: https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/sasp/Summary_Conclusions.html

#### `summary-stft-two-views-1` - difficulty 1; concepts: stft, overlap-add, filter-bank-summation, summary

**Q.** The summary recalls two equivalent interpretations of the STFT. What are they?

- (a) A sequence of FFTs (overlap-add view), or a downsampled uniform filter-bank output (filter-bank-summation view)
- (b) A wavelet transform, or a constant-Q transform
- (c) A linear prediction model, or a cepstral model
- (d) A time-domain convolution, or a frequency-domain multiplication

Hint 1: One view looks along the time axis (frames), the other along the frequency axis (bins).

Hint 2: The abbreviations are OLA and FBS.

**Answer: (a).** The book develops both viewpoints: the overlap-add (OLA) view treats the STFT as a succession of FFTs of windowed frames, while the filter-bank-summation (FBS) view treats each FFT bin as the downsampled output of a bandpass channel. Wavelet and constant-Q transforms (b) are the nonuniform banks covered separately; (c) names spectral-envelope methods; (d) is the convolution theorem, not an STFT interpretation.
